response.sql: WITH rental_by_rating AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) AS rental_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), total_rentals AS (SELECT SUM(rental_count) AS total FROM rental_by_rating), rating_shares AS (SELECT rbr.rental_count, rbr.rental_count / tr.total AS rating_share FROM rental_by_rating rbr CROSS JOIN total_rentals tr), avg_share_calc AS (SELECT AVG(rating_share) AS avg_share FROM rating_shares) SELECT SUM(rs.rental_count) AS combined_rented_films, AVG(rs.rating_share) AS average_share, AVG(rs.rating_share - asc.avg_share) AS average_above_average FROM rating_shares rs CROSS JOIN avg_share_calc asc WHERE rs.rating_share > asc.avg_share

assumptions.assumption: Share expressed as a decimal proportion (0.0–1.0); combined_rented_films counts individual rental events, not distinct films.

alternatives.interpretation: Counting distinct films rented at least once per rating, rather than total rental events.
